questions.explanation: Blade Runner adapts Dick's 1968 novel about empathy and artificial life.

questions.question: In Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?, the Voight-Kampff test detects lack of what in androids?
While writing about empathy in Androids, Dick was a heavy user of what stimulant?
questions.explanation: Dick used amphetamines heavily through the 1960s to keep up a punishing writing pace.

questions.question: After years on amphetamines, in 1974 Dick reported a vision delivered by a beam of what color light?
questions.explanation: He had largely quit by then, after a 1972 rehab stay; in early 1974 he described a pink beam of light delivering knowledge straight into his mind.

questions.question: That pink beam vision led Dick to name VALIS—Vast Active Living what?
questions.explanation: Dick framed VALIS as a cosmic information network.
